subject: [PATCH v5 09/12] mm/hugetlb: retry the pool walk when the zonelist is rebuilt

2026-11-01.patch_summary: This patch addresses a problem where a hugetlb fault bound to one node can take a pool page from another due to the way the zonelist is rebuilt during zone onlining. The patch introduces checks for zonelist updates and retries the pool walk if the zonelist has changed, ensuring that pages are taken from the correct node. This change fixes an issue where kprobes holding the walk across the online could cause a fault to take a page from the wrong node.
